_about: Public-domain Nathaniel William Taylor (1786-1858), Dwight professor of didactic theology at Yale and author of the New Haven Theology, for the Word Hoard: the Concio ad Clerum (preached 1828, this printing 1842), the Practical Sermons (1858), the Lectures on the Moral Government of God (1859, two volumes), the Essays, Lectures, etc. upon Select Topics in Revealed Theology (1859), and his correspondence with Joel Hawes (1832), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 39 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
